acceptanceCriteria: Reproduction with an untracked file in a clean checkout is a test fixture.
dogfood-change either ignores untracked paths or refuses naming them and the recovery.
body: During the PR #1073 fix round (2026-10-17, head 9585a3d45), untracked review.txt and codex-prompt.txt in the lane checkout made `make dogfood-change` fail with record-index-failed while `git status` showed nothing staged or modified. Expected: untracked, unstaged files are ignored or named in a refusal with a recovery. Actual: opaque failure; workaround was moving the files aside.

completion.reason: Delivered on main c9ca8beff43d8f548b054d3b3d40e3054cecf816 via batch beamfall/corvint#1399 (lane #1393); CI green on that commit (runs 39571877340). title: dogfood-change fails record-index-failed on untracked files in a clean-status checkout
